Qihuang Meridian Atlas - user-supplied model provenance

The adult male and female v3 body meshes and diffuse textures were supplied by
the project owner in lux3d_model_exports.zip and result.zip on 2026-10-15,
as exports generated using Aholo Lux3D from this project's reference images.

Local processing preserves source geometry, binds the supplied diffuse image,
normalizes scale/orientation, and prepares embedded-texture GLB files.
Original upload digests are recorded in src/assets/anatomy/models.manifest.json.

These uploads are not MakeHuman/MPFB assets and are not claimed to have a CC0
license. This provenance notice does not grant a new license or certify the
owner's Aholo account terms or competition eligibility.

The original project MIT license and separately attributed dependencies remain
as documented in the project. Historical MPFB assets retain their CC0 notices.
The separate organ layer and meridian curves are project-authored teaching
illustrations, not clinically validated anatomical reconstructions.
